lines.zh: 我踩着空气，一步步往上。
lines.en: I walk up the air, step by step.
I land light, as if weightless.
This body is far too agile.
I walked right over your head.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，风还没散。
lines.en: The wind has not caught up with me.
I do not care for walking slowly.

lines.zh: 两条腿一蹬，就滑出去了。
lines.en: Two legs push off and I glide away.
I roll my shoulders as I go.
A few steps cover that distance.

lines.zh: 我踩在碎石上，没有声音。
lines.en: I cross the gravel without a sound.
I turn and walk backward.
I am looking for someone worth stopping for.
I stand still, and still sway.
Standing like this is dull.
The wind comes. I let it pass.
My ki is steady, unruffled.
I reach out and grab a fistful of air.
I could use that move again.
I blink and the light dims.
These clothes do not fit well.
I wonder who breaks first.
I pivot half a turn on my toes.
Not hungry, not hurried.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天上什么也没有。
lines.en: I look up. Nothing there.
You stand there. I see you.
Do we fight or talk?
I am checking whether you have nerve.
One smile from you and I will know.

lines.zh: 你这副样子，像来试探的。
lines.en: You look like you came to test me.
I do not dislike you.
Hold still and let me look.
I raise a hand in greeting.
Your ki is muddled, poorly trained.
You speak softly. I cannot hear.
There are a few steps between us.

lines.zh: 这几步，我可以一步跨过去。
lines.en: I could cross them in one.
Closer and I will stop being polite.

lines.zh: 魔人糖果，你要不要尝一颗？
lines.en: Would you care for a taste of my Majin candy?
I stumble a step.
That one hurt.

lines.zh: 超级乌普的气，晃了半圈。
lines.en: Majuub's ki wavers half a turn.
I touch the wound.
Still able to move. Good.
Do not think that wins it.
Half a step back, then steady.
I have taken this pain before.
Come at me again.
Food? I do not much care.
Is that much enough?
I take one piece.
Not bad. Another.
I eat quickly.
Not even a mouthful.
I toss it up and catch it.
Do you have more on you?
I am not fussy, so long as it is food.
I leave once I am done.
You bumped me and I wobbled.
We collided and neither gave way.
I am lighter than you think.
Do not push. My footing is unsure.
I slip past your shoulder.
We are too close.
I stepped aside and you nearly fell.
Call out before you bump into me next time.
You are rather close.

lines.zh: 我们一起坐着，什么也不说。
lines.en: We sit together saying nothing.
One person in this world is enough.

lines.zh: 我身上还有些魔人的东西。
lines.en: There is still some Majin in me.
That much, I fear, could hurt you.
I am not good at pretty words.
Sitting like this is enough.
I will not leave before dawn.
Something on the ground. I pick it up.
Who left this here?
I stuff it in my pocket.
No use. I toss it.
I turn it all the way around.
Want it? Take it.
I hold it and play with it a while.
This thing makes a noise.
I have put it away.
Then it is you.
I have my eyes on you.
Hold still. I am coming.
This fight cannot be dodged.
You provoked me just now.
My leg is already up.
Ki gathers under my feet.
This distance is close enough.
I do not need to charge.
I am fast. You are slow.
I lock my ki onto you.
I remember what you said.
I am coming now.
Better not blink.
I do not look twice when I strike.
I circle around you.

lines.zh: 你转身，我已经在另一边。
lines.en: You turn, and I am on the other side.
I lift a foot and you must dodge.
Your guard has gaps.
I strike and watch at once.
The more you rush, the more you err.
A blast comes from the side.
I am in the shadow behind you.
An afterimage stays behind.
You struck nothing.
I am not tired. You are panting.
I am saving this kick.
Waiting for you to leave a gap.
Now is the moment.
Your foot moved too soon.

lines.zh: 我踩着你刚才站的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you stood a moment ago.

lines.zh: 这一圈走完，你就没路了。
lines.en: When this circle closes, you have nowhere left.
A kick lands on your flank.
Three kicks, no pause.
Elbow and knee together.
Blasts chase you down.
I strike fast enough that you cannot follow.
That one was a feint.
The real one is here.
I kick you into the air.
Then a ki wave.
Try the Majin candy.
What have you turned into?
I step back to watch.
This round is mine.
Do you still want more?
I pull the kick back and land steady.
I leap out of the light.
My feet barely touch before I bounce up.
Where is this place?
The air is clean. Unfamiliar.
I land without a sound.
I take one look around.
Ki is moving somewhere far off.
This world's gravity is normal.
I roll my shoulders.
This body can still fight.
I hang in the air for a moment.
Enough room here to run.
There is a human scent.
I land on a tree.
The tree sways and I hold.

lines.zh: 任务把我放这儿，先看看四周。
lines.en: A mission placed me here; first I look around.
I raise a hand and the light scatters.
Whatever else, let me start moving.
Fire on my arm, and I shake it off.
I fall and my knee takes the hit.
Water in my nose. I jerk my head up.
The blast shoves me back.
Something sticks in my leg.
A hex locks down my ki.
Half a day hungry and my strength lags.
Lightning hits my shoulder and half of me goes numb.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我在落。
lines.en: Nothing below. I am falling.
